items.headline: 16-unit apartment building permitted on Bradford Way
items.summary: A new 16-unit multi-family building at 1803 Bradford Wy has received its building permit, with construction valued at about $1.81 million.

items.headline: Advantest permitted for $12M facility upgrade on Orchard Drive
items.summary: A tenant improvement permit worth $12 million was issued for Advantest at 3055 Orchard Dr, one of the largest commercial permits in this batch.

items.headline: Cleary Gottlieb sign permit points to law firm at 151 University
items.summary: A sign permit was issued for channel letters reading 'Cleary Gottlieb' at 151 University Av, suggesting the international law firm is taking space in the downtown commercial district.

items.headline: PopUp Bagels signage permit signals new University Ave shop
items.summary: A permit was issued for signage on an existing canopy and a hanging sign for 'PopUp Bagels' at 164 University Av, pointing to a new bagel shop opening in the space.

items.headline: Council to consider ballot measure on business tax overhaul
items.summary: The council is set to consider a resolution asking voters to approve switching Milpitas' business tax to a gross receipts model, where taxes are based more directly on a business's revenue. The proposal notes about 85% of Milpitas businesses have small enough gross receipts that they would fall into protected lower tax tiers.
